tweets.author: thejohnnycrypto.bsky.social
tweets.text: I've used Bitcoin since 2015. Before I trust a privacy tool I ask how many people already use it. Builders, which privacy feature would you ship on by default?

tweets.author: thejohnnycrypto.bsky.social
tweets.text: I think of that crowd by its name: the anonymity set, the group of people you could be mistaken for. Bitcoin writes every payment to a public ledger, and privacy tools like coinjoin hide you inside a crowd of payments. They work only as well as the crowd is big.
